create.name: Kripalu Center for Yoga & Health
create.bio:
Kripalu Center for Yoga & Health is a non-profit centre for yoga education in the Berkshire hills of western Massachusetts, on a campus of more than 100 acres above Stockbridge, close to Lake Mahkeenac. It is named after Swami Kripalu, an Indian yoga master whose name means compassion and whose core teaching, to watch oneself without judging, still shapes the way yoga is taught there. The community began in Pennsylvania in the early 1970s as a residential yoga fellowship, moved in 1983 into a former Jesuit seminary at Stockbridge, and later re-formed as a secular educational charity. It now calls itself the largest retreat centre in North America.

Most guests come for a residential programme lasting from a weekend to a week. Many are led by visiting presenters; others are house retreats taught by Kripalu's own faculty, such as silent weekends, seasonal Ayurveda stays and outdoor programmes built around hiking, archery and walks in the woods. A self-guided Retreat & Renewal stay, overnight or as a day pass, comes with meals and a daily timetable of yoga, meditation and short workshops. Four schools offer professional training: yoga teaching, Ayurveda, yoga therapy and leading mindful time outdoors. At home, people can join the Kripalu Online Studio, which streams more than twenty live classes a week and keeps a large library of recordings, or watch some campus programmes live.

courses.title: Kripalu Programs & Retreats
courses.description: The full calendar of residential and online programmes at Kripalu, searchable by date, theme and teacher. It mixes workshops by visiting authors and teachers with the centre's own Kripalu Experience Programs. Tuition is listed separately from lodging and meals, which start at $109 a night midweek.

courses.title: Retreat & Renewal (R&R)
courses.description: An unstructured stay on the Stockbridge campus with no fixed programme. Meals, drop-in yoga and meditation classes, guided outdoor walks and short daily workshops are all included and all optional; bodywork is extra. Day passes are also sold, and there are scholarships for both.

courses.title: Kripalu Schools
courses.description: Kripalu's four professional schools: the School of Yoga (200-hour and advanced teacher trainings, on campus and online), the School of Ayurveda, the School of Integrative Yoga Therapy and the School of Mindful Outdoor Leadership. Trainings run as residential modules or online cohorts across the year.

courses.title: Kripalu Online Studio
courses.description: A subscription to Kripalu's online classes: over twenty live sessions each week in several yoga styles, meditation and pranayama, plus a library of more than 2,500 recordings that also covers Ayurveda and nature connection. A free trial is offered, and full scholarships are available.
courses.price: $39 USD a month or $365 a year

courses.title: The Kripalu Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A five-day house retreat taught by Kripalu teachers for people at any level, from first-timers to long-time practitioners. Days alternate led group classes in the Kripalu style with free time for personal practice and reflection, in a setting meant to take the pressure off performing.

courses.title: Essential Practices for Everyday Life
courses.description: Kripalu's signature introductory weekend, run by its own faculty: Kripalu Yoga both as posture practice and as a way of living, meditation, mindfulness and simple daily self-care habits drawn from the teachings of Swami Kripalu, adjusted to the season.

courses.title: Ayurveda Self-Care Retreat
courses.description: A three-night house programme with Kripalu faculty on Ayurveda as daily ritual: learning one's constitution through the doshas, building seasonal routines, food rituals, oil self-massage and time outdoors with the elements. Open to newcomers and experienced students alike.

courses.title: The Kripalu Silent Retreat
courses.description: Kripalu's most popular house retreat: a weekend held in silence, meals included, apart from brief talks and question times. Kripalu faculty guide embodied meditation, mindful movement, journaling and practice outside on the grounds. The rest of the campus is not silent.

courses.title: Winter Solstice Retreat: Nature, Peace, and Connection
courses.description: A solstice weekend led by Micah Mortali, who founded Kripalu's School of Mindful Outdoor Leadership. It pairs guided time outdoors and fire meditations with the Nordic idea of hygge, the seasonal festivals of the Celtic calendar and what Ayurveda says about winter.

courses.title: Winter Ayurveda Retreat: Harmony, Rejuvenation, and Rest
courses.description: A midweek house retreat with Kripalu faculty on Ayurvedic self-care for the cold months: eating with the season, warming meals cooked together, balancing yoga, meditation and abhyanga, the Ayurvedic practice of oil self-massage.

free_resources.title: Living Kripalu
free_resources.description: Kripalu's free online magazine of articles, practices, teacher interviews and recipes, sorted by themes such as yoga and ancient wisdom, movement, creativity, nature and relationships.

free_resources.title: Kripalu on YouTube
free_resources.description: Free videos from Kripalu teachers and visiting presenters, including short yoga and meditation practices, talks and glimpses of life on the campus.
